_comment: Build matrix for XC_VM_FFMPEG. Source of truth for local builds is the bash arrays in build_ffmpeg_all.sh; this file mirrors them for humans/CI. Keep in sync.

ffmpeg_versions._comment: panel label (asset name + panel ffmpeg_bin/<label> bucket) -> ffmpeg release tarball version to compile.

distros._comment: distro tag (asset suffix) -> docker base image. Rocky_9 is TODO: build_ffmpeg.sh is apt-only and needs a dnf port of install_build_tools.
